blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Metro Pacific Iloilo Water has begun operating a P150-million water treatment facility, expanding potable water service to 1,000 additional households in La Paz, Iloilo City. The facility, which treats brackish groundwater, is the first of five planned treatment plants intended to bolster regional supply during El Niño periods. READ: Metro Pacific Water earmarks […]...
